records.description: Records kept in the document for this source.
records.title: Records

in_window.description: Kept records whose time is in the window.
in_window.title: In Window

out_of_window.description: Kept records whose time is outside the window.
out_of_window.title: Out Of Window

untimed.description: Kept records with a missing, malformed or zoneless time.
untimed.title: Untimed

duplicates_dropped.description: Rows identical, field for field, to a row already read: not kept twice.
duplicates_dropped.title: Duplicates Dropped

conflicting.description: Repeats of a record id whose native row differs from the first one read.
conflicting.title: Conflicting

malformed.description: Rows that are not JSON objects: counted, never made into records.
malformed.title: Malformed

Coverage.description: What part of the requested window the source covered.

queried_window.description: The window sent upstream; null when no request was sent.

window_coverage.description: covered: the whole requested window was queried and every page read; unknown: the drain stopped early; not_covered: the source failed.
window_coverage.title: Window Coverage

Coverage.title: Coverage

Entity.description: One exact identifier the record names.

id.description: The identifier exactly as the record gives it.
id.title: Id

role.description: The native field or parameter that holds it.
role.title: Role

Entity.title: Entity

EpochWarning.description: A warning about a window bound that is negative or looks like epoch milliseconds.

value.description: The value as given (epoch seconds); it was sent unchanged.
value.title: Value

message.description: What was sent and what to pass instead.
message.title: Message

EpochWarning.title: EpochWarning

EventTime.description: When the event happened, as the record states it, and where it falls in the window.

status.description: in_window / out_of_window for a usable time; missing, malformed or ambiguous_timezone (no UTC offset) when the record gives no usable time.
status.title: Status

field.description: The native field the time was read from.
field.title: Field

original_type.description: JSON type of the native value.
original_type.title: Original Type

utc.description: UTC ISO 8601 time; null without a usable time.
utc.title: Utc

epoch_ms.description: Epoch milliseconds; null without a usable time.
epoch_ms.title: Epoch Ms

precision.description: Precision the native value carries; null without a usable time.
precision.title: Precision

EventTime.title: EventTime

evidence_id.description: Stable id: SOURCE_ID|id|NATIVE_ID, or SOURCE_ID|sha256:DIGEST for a record without a native id; a conflicting repeat adds |v:DIGEST.
evidence_id.title: Evidence Id

product.description: The product that served the record.
product.title: Product

source_id.description: The source the record came from.

time.description: The event time and its window placement.

Failure.description: Why a source produced no evidence.

kind.description: unsupported (HTTP 404/405/501), permission_denied (403), auth_failed (401), rejected (another 4xx), unavailable (5xx, 429 or no answer), parse_failed (an answer of an unexpected shape).
kind.title: Kind

http_status.description: Upstream HTTP status; null without one.
http_status.title: Http Status

message.description: The upstream error text, with configured secrets masked.
message.title: Message

Failure.title: Failure

status.description: exact: every identifier has a known role and form; ambiguous: a role or form is unstated or two identifiers conflict; missing: no identifier in known fields.
status.title: Status

reason.description: Why the status is ambiguous or missing; else null.

entities.description: The identifiers, ordered by role and id.
entities.title: Entities

NetworkAttributes.description: The safe Network system-log fields kept for a record (free text is never kept).

severity.description: Severity as the controller states it.
severity.title: Severity

target.description: What the event targets, e.g. DEVICE.
target.title: Target

wrong_typed_fields.description: Native fields that are present with a value of the wrong JSON type and so are null here. A field that is simply absent (or null) is not listed.
wrong_typed_fields.title: Wrong Typed Fields

NetworkAttributes.title: NetworkAttributes

ObservedWindow.description: The earliest and latest in-window event times a source returned (null when none).

earliest.title: Earliest

latest.description: Latest in-window event time, UTC ISO 8601.
latest.title: Latest

earliest_epoch_ms.description: Earliest in-window event time, epoch ms.

latest_epoch_ms.description: Latest in-window event time, epoch ms.

Pagination.description: How much of the source's listing was read.

truncated.description: truncated when the drain stopped early (the opt-in page cap, a repeated or early-empty page, or a short declared total); else not_truncated.

reason.description: Why the drain stopped early; else null.

upstream_total.description: The total the API declared, when it declared one.
upstream_total.title: Upstream Total

page_cap.description: UNIFI_PAGINATE_MAX_PAGES when the operator set it; else null (no cap).

ProtectAttributes.description: The safe Protect event fields kept for a record (descriptions and media are never kept).

type.description: Event type, e.g. motion or smartDetectZone.
type.title: Type

smart_detect_types.description: Smart-detect subtypes, e.g. person; null when the event has none.
smart_detect_types.title: Smart Detect Types

score.description: Detection score as the event states it.
score.title: Score

end_epoch_ms.description: Event end, epoch milliseconds, when the event gives an integer end.

wrong_typed_fields.description: Native fields that are present with a value of the wrong JSON type (or, for smartDetectTypes, with a non-string entry that was left out) and so are null or reduced here. A field that is simply absent (or null) is not listed.

camera_id.description: Protect camera filter; null for all cameras.

event_types.description: Protect event types sent as a filter; null when not filtered.

Window.description:
A half-open UTC window: ``start`` inclusive, ``end`` exclusive.

The ``*_epoch_ms`` fields are authoritative. An ISO bound is null exactly when its epoch
value lies outside 0001-01-01T00:00:00.000Z to 9999-12-31T23:59:59.999Z (a value a
caller passed in the wrong unit is still sent and reported, never refused).

start.description: Window start, UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds (inclusive); null when start_epoch_ms is outside years 1 to 9999.
start.title: Start

end.description: Window end, UTC ISO 8601 with milliseconds (exclusive); null when end_epoch_ms is outside years 1 to 9999.
end.title: End

Window.title: Window

description: Normalized incident evidence from one product on one console.

status.description: complete: every source complete or empty with at least one complete; empty: every source empty; failed: every source failed; partial: anything else.
status.title: Status

causality.description: Always not_assessed: records are ordered by time only and no record is claimed to cause another.
causality.title: Causality

ordering.description: Records sort by event time, product, source id, native record id and evidence id; records without a usable time sort last.
ordering.title: Ordering

requested_window.description: The window the caller asked for.

collected_at.description: When the collection ran, UTC ISO 8601; never used as an event time.
collected_at.title: Collected At

incomplete.description: True exactly when some source is truncated (its drain stopped early); the repo-wide signal that this is not everything the console holds.
incomplete.title: Incomplete

incompleteReason.description: Why the document is incomplete, naming each truncated source. Present only when incomplete is true (like every other result that carries the flag).
incompleteReason.title: Incompletereason

_warnings.description: One entry per window bound that is negative or looks like epoch milliseconds (the repo-wide epoch warning); the bound was sent unchanged. Present only when there is one.
_warnings.title: Warnings
